title.zh-CN: 额外允许的公网主机名

description.zh-CN: 除公网地址中的域名外，公网监听端口还接受这些主机名，例如反向代理使用的其他域名。
description.en-US: Host names the public listener accepts besides the one in the public address, such as another domain your reverse proxy uses.

description.zh-CN: 公网门户中文界面显示的服务名称。
description.en-US: The service name the public portal shows in Chinese.

description.zh-CN: 公网门户英文界面显示的服务名称。
description.en-US: The service name the public portal shows in English.

description.zh-CN: 公网门户的模型目录和状态页列出哪些模型，可用 * 通配，例如 qwen*；只写 * 表示全部。
description.en-US: Which models the public catalog and status page list. Patterns may use *, for example qwen*; * alone lists every model.

description.zh-CN: 在公网模型目录中显示每个模型的计费价格。
description.en-US: Show each model's prices in the public model catalog.

title.zh-CN: 允许公网请求唤醒模型

description.zh-CN: 公网请求指向已休眠或未运行的模型时，是否允许自动唤醒或启动它。关闭时返回“模型未就绪”。
description.en-US: Whether a public request for a sleeping or stopped model may wake or start it. When off, the request gets a model-not-ready error.

title.zh-CN: 每个密钥默认每分钟请求数
title.en-US: Default requests per minute per key

description.zh-CN: 公网密钥没有单独设置时，每分钟最多可发送的请求数。
description.en-US: How many requests per minute a public key may send when it has no limit of its own.

title.zh-CN: 每个密钥默认每分钟令牌数
title.en-US: Default tokens per minute per key

description.zh-CN: 公网密钥没有单独设置时，每分钟最多可使用的输入加输出令牌数。
description.en-US: How many input plus output tokens per minute a public key may use when it has no limit of its own.

title.zh-CN: 每个密钥默认并发请求数

description.zh-CN: 公网密钥没有单独设置时，同时进行中的请求上限。
description.en-US: How many requests a public key may have in flight at once when it has no limit of its own.

title.zh-CN: 每个密钥默认排队请求数

description.zh-CN: 达到并发上限后，公网密钥最多可排队等待的请求数。
description.en-US: How many requests a public key may have waiting once it reaches its concurrency limit.

description.zh-CN: 排队的公网请求最多等待的秒数，超时后返回繁忙错误。
description.en-US: How many seconds a queued public request waits at most before it gets a busy error.

title.zh-CN: 默认单次最大输出令牌数
title.en-US: Default output token limit per request

description.zh-CN: 公网密钥没有单独设置时，单个请求最多可生成的输出令牌数。
description.en-US: The largest output a single public request may ask for when its key has no limit of its own.

description.zh-CN: 所有公网密钥合计同时进行中的请求上限，为本机自用保留算力。
description.en-US: How many public requests may be in flight at once across all keys, so the owner keeps capacity.

description.zh-CN: 所有公网密钥合计最多可排队等待的请求数。
description.en-US: How many public requests may wait in total across all keys.

description.zh-CN: 等待公网总并发名额的请求最多等待的秒数。
description.en-US: How many seconds a request waiting for a public slot waits at most.

title.zh-CN: 本机使用时的公网并发数
title.en-US: Public concurrency while the owner is active

description.zh-CN: 本机或控制台正在使用模型时，公网总并发请求降到这个数；它不能大于公网总并发请求数。
description.en-US: While the owner or the console is using the models, public requests in flight drop to this number. It cannot exceed the public total.

title.zh-CN: 验证前每个 IP 每分钟请求数
title.en-US: Requests per minute per IP before the key check

description.zh-CN: 验证密钥之前，每个来源 IP 每分钟最多可发送的请求数，用于拖慢扫描。
description.en-US: How many requests per minute one source IP may send before its key is checked, to slow down scanners.

title.zh-CN: 验证前每个 IP 突发请求数
title.en-US: Burst per IP before the key check

description.zh-CN: 每个来源 IP 在短时间内可以连续发送的请求数。
description.en-US: How many requests one source IP may send in a short burst.

description.zh-CN: 同一来源在统计窗口内密钥验证失败达到这个次数后被临时封禁。
description.en-US: How many failed key checks from one source within the window lead to a temporary ban.

description.zh-CN: 统计密钥验证失败次数所用的时间窗口。
description.en-US: The time window failed key checks are counted in.

description.zh-CN: 来源第一次被封禁的秒数，再次触发时逐步加长；不能大于最长封禁时长。
description.en-US: How many seconds the first ban of a source lasts; repeat bans grow longer. It cannot exceed the longest ban.

description.zh-CN: 逐步加长后封禁时长的上限。
description.en-US: The upper limit growing bans reach.

description.zh-CN: 公网单个请求体的最大字节数，超出时请求被拒绝。
description.en-US: The largest body a single public request may send, in bytes; larger requests are refused.

description.zh-CN: 允许带有搜索权限的公网密钥使用联网搜索接口。
description.en-US: Let public keys with the search permission use the web search API.

description.zh-CN: 允许带有语音权限的公网密钥调用语音合成接口。声音克隆始终只在本机可用。
description.en-US: Let public keys with the speech permission call the text-to-speech API. Voice cloning always stays on this machine.

description.zh-CN: 每日和每月额度按与 UTC 相差的这些分钟数切换周期；留空跟随计费中心的时区。
description.en-US: Daily and monthly quotas roll over at this offset from UTC, in minutes. Leave it empty to follow the billing time zone.

title.zh-CN: 管理器只接受入口转发

description.zh-CN: 模型管理器如何处理没有经过入口转发的模型请求：off 照常处理，warn 处理并记录，enforce 拒绝。
description.en-US: How the model managers treat model requests that did not come through the entry: off serves them, warn serves and logs them, enforce refuses them.
